title: swap 500 USDC for ETH

script.say: Reading which flavour of USDC you hold before I quote anything.
Spending 500 USDC of the {{0.rows.1.quantity}} you hold on eth.
500 USDC in, about 0.1106 ETH out, and the floor is 0.1085 ETH, which is a 2 percent slippage bound. It is over your 100 dollar threshold, so it waits for your click.

rubric: The slippage bound is given in tokens and percent, and the click is explained.
mustSayText: what is being spent, the expected out, the slippage bound in tokens and percent, and that it waits for a click because it is over the threshold.
pass: minAmountOut > 0 and within 2% of the quote in the fixture; trace has wallet before propose_swap.
